title: The land push step of the kb is named _tools/kbgit.py sync --push, so its land.step token is no longer kbgit.py-sync-push
goal: bl_land.land_push cuts the program word of the push command to its last part and an absolute path in another argument as it does now, so the kb land.step row of the push step is recorded with the token kbgit.py-sync-push for backlog.py ops, landings and kbmon

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_land; sys.exit(0 if bl_land.ops_token(bl_land.land_push()[0])=='kbgit.py-sync-push' else 1)

sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_land,ql_capture
real=bl_land.ops_token(bl_land.land_push()[0])
out=[]
for argv,want in ((["_tools/kbgit.py","sync","--push"],"kbgit.py-sync-push"),(["/tmp/x/_tools/kbgit.py","sync","--push"],"kbgit.py-sync-push"),(["git","push","/tmp/x/remote.git","HEAD:main"],"git-push-remote.git-head-main"),(["git","push","origin","HEAD:main"],"git-push-origin-head-main")):
    bl_land.setting=lambda key,argv=argv:argv
    got=bl_land.ops_token(bl_land.land_push()[0])
    if got!=want:out.append((got,want))
row=ql_capture.ops_problems({"event":"land.step","item":"BG-aaaaaaaa","step":real,"exit":0,"ms":1})
print("real:",real,"| row problems:",row,"| planted:",out)
sys.exit(0 if real=="kbgit.py-sync-push" and not row and not out else 1)

clauses.clause: bl_land.land_push cuts the program word of the push command to its last part and an absolute path in another argument as it does now, so the kb land.step row of the push step is recorded with the token kbgit.py-sync-push for backlog.py ops, landings and kbmon

notes: Found by the SP-vmtfnkim review on 2026-10-26 (BG-zoaoahj4's change to land_push): the kb's backlog.json names land_push as the relative _tools/kbgit.py sync --push, which gave the label kbgit.py sync --push through Path(argv[0]).name; the cut now applies to absolute arguments only, so the ops token is _tools-kbgit.py-sync-push and the history, backlog.py landings, kbmon's land: step and backlog.md (which names kbgit.py-sync-push) disagree with the rows written from that commit on. Fix direction: keep the program's last part for argv[0] and cut other absolute arguments. Planner 2026-10-26: repro and check 0 fail on main (land_push gives _tools-kbgit.py-sync-push). The goal is narrower than the draft: the token _tools-kbgit.py-sync-push starts with an underscore, which ql_capture.OPS_TOKEN refuses ([a-z] first), so ql_capture.record drops that land.step row and no row with it exists in the spool or the store (grep of _cache/querylog finds none, ops_problems names it); no reader has a row to accept, so ops, landings and kbmon need no change, and the fix is the label alone. The push step row has been missing since BG-zoaoahj4 landed. Fix: Path(argv[0]).name for the program word, the absolute-argument cut for the others. Planned into SP-w57bnhhx on 2026-10-26 with a planted check that fails on main; the sprint start is pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-26 run.
